relations.subject: Kenneth Arthur Ballhatchet
relations.evidence: From 1941 studies at Peterhouse College in Cambridge. ... Back in Cambridge completed Historical Tripos in 1947.

relations.subject: Kenneth Arthur Ballhatchet
relations.role: Lecturer in the History of Modern India

relations.subject: Kenneth Arthur Ballhatchet
relations.evidence: After two years at Oxford as Reader in Indian History in 1963-65

relations.subject: Kenneth Arthur Ballhatchet
relations.role: Professor of the History of South Asia
relations.evidence: returned to S.O.A.S. as Professor of the History of South Asia. Retired in 1988 and was appointed Emeritus Professor.
